components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;color:var(--ink,#13426f);font:600 12px "Noto Sans KR",sans-serif}.ds-field input{background:var(--white,#fffef9);color:var(--ink,#13426f);border:1px solid #c4cec5;border-radius:7px;padding:11px 12px;font:400 14px "Noto Sans KR",sans-serif;caret-color:var(--blue,#267ac1)}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--muted,#5c6c74)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#267ac1);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-chips a{border:1px solid var(--line,#d9ddd5);padding:7px 16px;border-radius:100px;font:400 11px "Noto Sans KR",sans-serif;color:#4b6164;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s}.ds-chips a:hover{background:var(--mint,#dcecdf)}.ds-chips a[aria-current]{background:var(--ink,#13426f);border-color:var(--ink,#13426f);color:white}.ds-chips a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#267ac1);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-card{max-width:370px;color:var(--ink,#13426f);font-family:"Noto Sans KR",sans-serif}.ds-art{height:215px;background:#c8dfd3;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}.ds-art svg{width:100%;height:100%;transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-card:hover svg{transform:scale(1.035)}.ds-card small{display:block;margin-top:17px;font-size:11px;color:#487362}.ds-card h3{font-size:19px;line-height:1.5;margin:8px 0 0}.ds-card a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-card a:hover{color:var(--blue,#267ac1)}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#267ac1);outline-offset:4px}.ds-card p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--muted,#5c6c74);margin-top:10px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-art svg{transition:none}}

donts: Don't replace the established badminton mark with an unrelated identity.
Don't add shadows to the documented flat surface system without an intentional design revision.
Don't present sample editorial drafts or reserved advertising space as live editorial or paid inventory.
narrative.overview:
Warm paper, navy lettering and gentle sport illustrations give Korean badminton reading a welcoming, precise rhythm. The inherited Ohacle cream, navy, mint and peach identity is the durable brand commitment.

This is a code-first implementation, without a separate visual comp. Strong Korean headlines sit beside quiet English editorial details; generous panels frame discovery while reading surfaces remain calm.

rules.body: Use tonal separation and fine rules for depth, consistent with the implemented shadow-free surfaces.
rules.name: The Paper Surface Rule

dos: Do preserve the inherited cream, navy, mint and peach identity.
Do keep Korean headlines prominent and reading copy comfortably spaced.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain image provenance when reusing shipped assets.
keyCharacteristics: Strong Korean hierarchy and restrained English accents.
Rounded imagery, fine rules and visible interaction states.
